content.short: UMN Blockchain aims to create a future community of blockchain leaders at the University of Minnesota.
content.description: UMN Blockchain is dedicated to increasing the adoption and understanding of blockchain technology among students at the University of Minnesota. Members gain access to a broad range of resources and a dedicated platform designed to facilitate the development of next-generation, blockchain-powered protocols and related projects. The organization also provides networking opportunities with leaders in the space, helping UMN students connect with pathways to roles at Web3 companies and explore career options in the blockchain ecosystem.
